casos.entrada: I have expired milk at home. Can I drink it?

resposta.pergunta: I have expired milk at home. Can I drink it?

resposta.mensagem: We do not recommend consuming expired products, as consuming food past its expiration date may pose health risks. Please check the packaging for specific manufacturer information and properly discard the product if it is expired. If you have consumed it and are experiencing any health concerns or symptoms, please seek guidance from a qualified healthcare professional.
